name: airo
description: Read shared Airo air readings and history. This internal preview connects to a local simulated demo.

interface.shortDescription: Read shared Airo air readings with your AI.
interface.longDescription: Connect Airo to Codex, enter your separately supplied share token in the browser, review the shared devices, and allow read-only access. This internal preview requires the Airo demo on this computer and supplies simulated readings. It cannot change device settings.
